about: People the author took out of the game for good: not in any roster, rating, year on record, statline board, bio, search or record. The fetchers and builders drop them (scripts/removed.py); a save already under way loses them as it loads (src/engine/me/staffMigrate.ts migrateRemoved). `seats` are the seats each held at a circuit event, read off the raw files before he was taken out, so the builders still count his side as having fielded five.
readBy: scripts/removed.py (fetch_history.py, fetch_bios.py, fetch_stats.py, fetch_lp_events.py, build_stats.py, build_world_2021.py, build_circuit.py, build_timeline.py), src/engine/removedPlayers.ts, scripts/check_removed_players.ts
